concept: Information about a link and the annotation model
current_formulation: The W3C Web Annotation Data Model stores an annotation as a resource of its own with body, target, creator, and creation time, and points into a given version of the target.

steps.formulation: Enquire links carry a type and may carry a comment.
steps.quote: and may also have comment associated with it.

criticism.quote: This perverts the data model significantly, and I cannot see that that is a good idea.

steps.formulation: Information about a link belongs in the source node or in an intermediate node such as an annotation, not on the link.
steps.quote: Information about the link can always be put in the source node, or in an intermediate node, for example an annotation.

steps.formulation: The W3C model makes the annotation a set of connected resources, usually a body and a target, with creator, creation time, selectors, and states.
steps.quote: An annotation is considered to be a set of connected resources, typically including a body and target

criticism.quote: is very brittle with regards to changes to the resource.
